title.en: H-WILD conference: leave one user out; CSI amplitude of 4 APs x 3 antennas x 30 subcarriers
title.zh: H-WILD 会议室：留一用户交叉验证；4 个 AP × 3 天线 × 30 子载波的 CSI 幅度

dataset.name: hwild
dataset.crs: local (one frame per room; see building)
dataset.citation: Zhang, Zhang, Wang, Li, Hu, Sun, Chen, RLoc: Towards Robust Indoor Localization by Quantifying Uncertainty, Proc. ACM IMWUT 7(4), 2023
dataset.license: not stated by the repository (cite the RLoc paper)

protocol.name: benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT
protocol.summary: each user (groups['user']) tests once, trained on the other users of the same selection

skips.en: every training packet has its own position (22,970 packets, 22,970 distinct positions), so every per-location Gaussian would be fitted to a single packet; a probe in the conference room (fold user=1: 17,663 training packets, 200 test packets) took 170 ms per test packet, about 65 minutes for that room's 22,970 test packets and more for the larger rooms, beyond the 30-minute limit
skips.zh: 每个训练数据包的位置都不同（22,970 packets, 22,970 distinct positions），每个逐位置高斯模型只有一个数据包；在会议室的探测（留出用户 1 的一折：训练 17,663 个、测试 200 个数据包）每个测试数据包耗时 170 ms，该房间 22,970 个测试数据包约需 65 分钟，更大的房间更久，超出 30 分钟限制

skips.en: positions are continuous (17,596-19,503 distinct training positions): the fit runs an O(n^3) Cholesky of an n x n kernel matrix (3.0 GB in float64) at each of the 144 hyper-parameter grid points
skips.zh: 位置连续（训练集 17,596-19,503 个不同位置）：拟合需在 144 个超参数网格点上各做一次 n×n 核矩阵（float64 为 3.0 GB）的 O(n^3) Cholesky 分解

skips.en: the Torres-Sospedra representations are defined for RSSI in dBm, not CSI
skips.zh: Torres-Sospedra 表示针对 dBm 的 RSSI，不适用于 CSI

skips.en: model-based RSSI methods; the CSI amplitude is not a received power per anchor
skips.zh: 基于 RSSI 模型的方法；CSI 幅度不是每个锚点的接收功率

notes.en: Pooled over the leave-one-user-out folds (every packet tested once, by a model that never saw that user). Walks with and without interference are both included.
notes.zh: 对留一用户各折合并统计（每个数据包由从未见过该用户的模型测试一次）。包含有干扰与无干扰两类行走。

cells.command: indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method benchmarks.baselines:TrainingCentroid --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference
indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method 'knn(k=1)' --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference
indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method knn --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference
indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference

indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method 'rf(n_jobs=8)' --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference

indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method 'extratrees(n_jobs=8)' --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference

display: ensemble: median of WKNN, RF, extra trees
集成：WKNN/RF/极端随机树 中位数
cells.command: indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method 'ensemble(localizers=["wknn","rf","extratrees"],combine="median")' --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference
indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method mlp --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference
indoorloc benchmark --dataset hwild --protocol benchmarks.protocols:LEAVE_ONE_USER_OUT --preprocess CSIAmplitude --method svm --seed 0 --no-download -q --dataset-option environment=conference
